contains.spu_object_hit_admission_613: REWINDBOX_SPU_OBJECT_HIT_ADMISSION_613 (SPULLVMRecompiler.cpp compile()): the SPU object cache is read and validated before the LLVM compile admission; a hit of a block of at most 16 KiB no longer takes the admission (128 MiB minimum per job, at most 3 jobs, 1 under pressure); a miss, a rejected object or a larger block is admitted as before. Black Ops II Build 612 logs: 6,376 hits and 0 misses in one window, JITMEM active_peak=1, llvm_budget_cv 10.8 s. COREPROF ZCULLSYNC613 reports per window the ZCULL report reads that gathered occlusion queries (count:total_ms:max_ms, submission and MoltenVK wait included), the reads that had to submit the open command buffer, the zcull_sync hints that submitted ahead of a read, and precise/relaxed. contains.zcull_poll_no_wait_616: REWINDBOX_ZCULL_POLL_NO_WAIT_616 (VKGSRender.cpp check_occlusion_query_status): a non-forced ZCULL poll reports a query ready only when gathering its host queries (one per command buffer it spans, oldest first until the first hit, all of them in precise mode) will not wait for the GPU; upstream checks only the oldest one, so a poll whose oldest part found no hit waited in MoltenVK for the command buffer a zcull_sync hint had just submitted. Same values, same report order (the poll still stops at the first query not ready), forced reads (sync, read barriers, conditional render) unchanged. Assassin's Creed Build 614 logs (PID 64664, windows 20-33): 4.1-4.4 s of every 5 s window inside report reads whatever their number (31,500-48,300), result_flushes 0, hint_flushes equal to the submissions; frame time fits 24.2 ms + 8.7 us per draw + 0.655 ms per submitted command buffer (R2 0.937, windows 12-37)
contains.zcull_wait_probe_616: REWINDBOX_ZCULL_WAIT_PROBE_616 (VKQueryPool.cpp, RSXZCULL.cpp, RSXThread.cpp, IOSRsxSyncProfile.h, RPCS3IOSPerformance.cpp): measurement only. COREPROF ZCULLWAIT616 splits the MoltenVK wait (vkGetQueryPoolResults with WAIT) by the path that asked for the result (poll, forced read, conditional render, sync), counts the gathers per path and the polls the 616 change deferred
contains.zclip_window_z_616: REWINDBOX_ZCLIP_WINDOW_Z_616 (RSXVertexPrologue.glsl, GLSLTypes.h, GLSLCommon.cpp, VKVertexProgram.cpp, title lever): Black Ops II (BLES01717) only. Without float64 nor an unrestricted depth range (MoltenVK) the vertex fallback compresses Z above 1 into [0.99, 1] from window Z (d) instead of clip-space Z (pos.z). The BLES01717 capture of RPCS3 issue #13227 draws 26 of 4,023 draws with clip [1, 1e19], viewport Z scale 1e19 over offset 1, reversed depth GEQUAL (12-draw depth prepass, 12-draw colour pass, 2 blended); the upstream fallback gives every fragment of those draws depth 1.0 (host test), so the colour pass keeps the last triangle drawn instead of the nearest; with window Z the depth follows the view distance (1.0 to 0.9901). The SPIR-V of every other title is byte-identical (glslang); Black Ops II vertex Metal libraries are compiled again once
contains.spu_object_prefetch_616: REWINDBOX_SPU_OBJECT_PREFETCH_616 (ios/IOSSpuObjectPrefetch.h, JITLLVM.cpp, SPUCommonRecompiler.cpp, System.cpp, title lever): Black Ops II (BLES01717) only. After the SPU object-cache eviction plan, one utility-class thread reads the title's compressed objects into memory (newest first, 48 MiB budget, objects up to 256 KiB); a compile thread takes an object's bytes once and inflates and validates them as after its own read; an object not read yet is claimed and read from disk as before, never awaited; the store is emptied when emulation stops. Build 614 logs: 7,162 object reads (4,300.8 ms, 0.6 ms each) in the first window of a multiplayer match with the 2,038.7 ms frame 2388, and a 613-read burst with the 1,121.4 ms frame 3537, both without a blocking pipeline. JITCacheCompatibility.cmake maps the exact JITLLVM.cpp and SPUCommonRecompiler.cpp to their delivered Core 613 effective hashes
contains.core616_20261102: the Core 616 record (Core 613 record, ZCULL poll without wait and its probe for every title; Black Ops II pinned-depth window Z and SPU object read-ahead), unchanged in behaviour; build-utils/rpcs3/core619-from-616.patch (insertions only) turns its files into the Core 619 files
contains.zcull_on_demand_619: REWINDBOX_ZCULL_ON_DEMAND_619 (ios/IOSZcullOnDemand.h, RSXZCULL.cpp/.h, RPCS3IOSPerformance.cpp, title lever): Assassin's Creed (BLES00158, BLUS30089) only. Upstream marks a report location 'accessed' for the rest of the boot after the first guest access to a page that still holds a pending report; every report is then critical and every label write with a pipe flush, WAIT_FOR_IDLE or NOTIFY waits for the GPU in ZCULL_control::sync(). Build 617 logs (PID 65755, session 1, windows 17-28): 2,203-2,911 such waits per 5 s window, 4.15-4.32 s in all, every other ZCULL read path at 0 (COREPROF ZCULLWAIT616), 14-17 FPS. With the lever, report pages stay protected: a PPU or SPU access to a page with a pending report asks the RSX thread (pipe_flush_interrupt) to write every claimed report as sync() does, waits for it, then unprotects the page; an RSX copy out of report memory (NV0039, NV3089) writes them first; the guest reads the same values, the labels no longer wait. 250 ms without service, more than 1,000 requests per second, any other faulting thread or a stopping emulator take the upstream path. COREPROF ZCULLDEMAND619 counts faults, services, waits, timeouts and, for every title, which access switched a location to the upstream mode
contains.zclip_pinned_affine_619: REWINDBOX_ZCLIP_PINNED_AFFINE_619 (RSXVertexPrologue.glsl, GLSLTypes.h, GLSLCommon.cpp, VKVertexProgram.cpp, title lever): Black Ops II (BLES01717) only, on top of REWINDBOX_ZCLIP_WINDOW_Z_616. The fallback compressed only window Z in (1, far] and passed every other vertex through; the pinned draws of the #13227 capture keep depth clip on and clamp off (NV4097_SET_ZMIN_MAX_CONTROL = 1), so a triangle with a vertex in front of the near plane (window Z above 1e19) mixed an unchanged vertex with compressed ones and Vulkan clipped its edges at about 1e-21 of their length (host test) instead of at the near plane: the part of the first-person arm crossing the near plane vanished (Build 617 report: no texture on the back of the arm). For a clip range wholly above 1 every vertex now takes the same affine map of [near, far] onto [0.99, 1], unclamped beyond far: the hardware clip point equals the RSX clip point (host test, 5 edges) and every vertex in (1, far] keeps its Core 616 value. The SPIR-V of every other shader is byte-identical (glslang); Black Ops II vertex Metal libraries are compiled again once
